body:
A ddl.Script is not just a list of strings. Honor OutsideTransaction, Transactional, MustReturnNoRows and SkipIf through Execute, and pin the connection for session locks. MySQL DDL commits implicitly, so a failure may leave schema changes without a ledger row. Make migrations safe to repeat and inspect partial state before retrying; PostgreSQL/SQLite transactional behavior cannot be assumed for MySQL.

Evidence: ds:block?id=ddl-contract-s2xdb9he; ds:block?id=migration-execute-hgdykxdq; ds:block?id=migration-ledger-h5dv2yvb. See docs/architecture.md and docs/operating-notes.md. Verified from the implementation and tests on 2026-11-01; server-test gates are explicitly distinguished from execution.
title: DDL flags and MySQL partial commits
